cards.a: Recursion is best when wanting to break down a problem into smaller pieces
Constant time — the operation takes the same time regardless of input size
Linear time — the operation scales proportionally with input size
Logarithmic time — input is halved each step (e.g., binary search)
O(1) — direct index access
O(n) — must traverse from head
O(1) average case with a good hash function
